name: qatlas-design
description: Design pack for qatlas: researched art direction, a strict no-slop house style measured in a real browser, and a look-and-fix loop for web pages and app screens.

interface.shortDescription: Art direction and a no-slop house style for web pages
interface.longDescription: Design pack for Qatlas. Deals researched directions (idea, composition, type, palette, pictures, section blueprints) from a library, enforces a strict no-ornament house style with a real-browser inspector, finds credited pictures in open collections and runs a look-and-fix loop on screenshots. Covers landing pages, marketing sites, portfolios and app screens such as dashboards. Needs Node 22+ and an installed Chrome, Edge or Chromium. Requires qatlas.
